authority_boundary: Collector accepts only trusted upstream normalized records. It does not authenticate native file/plan/source/build identities from their SHA strings; the caller must validate them before seal_normalized_record.
reviewed_properties: Bounded integer log grids produce exact physical powers-of-two Cartesian coverage.
Expected geometry reconstructed and exact canonical equality checked.
Unique tile IDs and unique raw receipt IDs enforced; missing tiles fail.
All normalized records retain six common authority bindings and exact expected coordinates.
Per-tile requested radius exponent and actual serialized halfwidth must both meet fixed derived cap.
Fraction endpoint sums introduce no roundoff; final component halfwidths explicitly checked.
No endpoint contribution, normalization, full-domain or production admission is performed.
